title: Is Instant Triple Talaq Still Valid in India?
desc: Instant triple talaq is void and a crime under a 2019 central law; in Uttarakhand a wife can still claim maintenance and custody from a magistrate.
keywords: talaq ke liye kya karna padega
muslim women protection of rights on marriage act 2019
why: Many people searching for talaq procedure still believe that a husband saying 'talaq' three times at once ends a marriage immediately, though this has been a punishable offence since 2019.
keyPoints: Instant triple talaq (talaq-e-biddat), spoken, written or by message, is void and illegal under section 3 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.
The husband can be jailed up to 3 years and fined under section 4, but only the wife or her relative can get the police to act.
Since the talaq has no legal effect, the marriage continues; the wife can still claim a subsistence allowance and custody of minor children from a Judicial Magistrate.
Only the wife can withdraw (compound) the complaint, and only with the magistrate's permission.

sections.h: Does saying talaq three times end a marriage in India?
p: No. Under section 3 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, any pronouncement of instant triple talaq by a Muslim husband is void and illegal, whether spoken, written, or sent by text message or any other electronic means. This central law applies across India, including Uttarakhand. The marriage does not end just because the husband has said the words.

The Act came into force from 19 September 2018, after Parliament replaced an earlier ordinance. It was passed following the Supreme Court's 2017 ruling in Shayara Bano that instant triple talaq violates fundamental rights.

sections.h: Can the husband be arrested for pronouncing talaq?
p: Section 4 makes pronouncing instant triple talaq punishable with up to three years' imprisonment and a fine. But section 7 says the police can register the case only if the wife herself, or someone related to her by blood or marriage, gives the information.

Bail is not automatic. The magistrate can release the husband on bail only after hearing the wife and being satisfied there are reasonable grounds to do so. Only the wife can agree to compound (settle) the case, and even then only with the magistrate's permission.

sections.h: What can a wife claim after talaq is pronounced?
p: Section 5 lets a wife on whom talaq is pronounced claim a subsistence allowance for herself and her dependent children, with the amount decided by a Judicial Magistrate of the first class in whose area she lives. Section 6 separately entitles her to custody of her minor children, again decided by the magistrate, regardless of personal law to the contrary.
These rights exist whether or not a police complaint is filed under section 4, so a wife is not left without support just because the marriage has not formally ended.

whatToDo: Keep any message, recording, or witness proof of when and how talaq was pronounced.
Approach the Judicial Magistrate of the first class for your area to claim subsistence allowance and custody, even without a criminal complaint.
If filing a police complaint under section 4, remember only the wife or her blood or marriage relative can give the information.
Take legal advice on your own facts before deciding whether to file, withdraw, or compound a complaint.

hi.title: क्या तीन तलाक अब भी मान्य है?
keyPoints: मुस्लिम महिला (विवाह अधिकार संरक्षण) अधिनियम, 2019 की धारा 3 के तहत एक साथ तीन बार तलाक कहना अमान्य और गैरकानूनी है, चाहे बोलकर कहा जाए या मैसेज से।
धारा 4 के तहत पति को 3 साल तक की सजा और जुर्माना हो सकता है, पर पुलिस सिर्फ पत्नी या उसके रिश्तेदार की शिकायत पर ही कार्रवाई कर सकती है।
तलाक का कानूनी असर न होने से विवाह जारी रहता है; पत्नी मजिस्ट्रेट से गुजारा भत्ता और बच्चों की कस्टडी मांग सकती है।
शिकायत वापस लेने (कंपाउंड करने) का अधिकार सिर्फ पत्नी को है, और वह भी मजिस्ट्रेट की अनुमति से।
p: हल्द्वानी और नैनीताल में भी कई लोग मानते हैं कि तीन बार तलाक कहते ही शादी खत्म हो जाती है, जबकि 2019 से यह एक दंडनीय अपराध है और विवाह पर इसका कोई कानूनी असर नहीं पड़ता।
